description: 8-CH Modbus RTU relay + optocoupler input module, RS485/5V TTL, 4800/9600/19200 baud. FC05/FC01: relay ch1-8 at coil addr 0-7 (0xFF00=on/0x0000=off). FC02: optocoupler input ch1-8 at discrete input addr 0-7. FC03 addr 0: device address R (1-255). FC03 addr 1000: baud rate status (2=4800,3=9600,4=19200). FC10 addr 1001: set baud rate. FC10 relay N flash mode: base addr=3+(N-1)*5, 2 regs (word1: 0x0004=flash-OFF, 0x0002=flash-ON; word2=delay×0.1s).

| LC Technology LC-Modbus-8R-D7 8-Channel Modbus RTU Relay Module
| Protocol: Modbus RTU; RS485 or 5V TTL UART; 4800/9600/19200 baud, default 9600
| FC05 (Write Single Coil): relay 1-8 at coil addresses 0x0000-0x0007 (0xFF00=ON, 0x0000=OFF)
| FC0F (Write Multiple Coils): addr 0x0000, count 8; data byte bit0-7 = relay 1-8
| FC01 (Read Coils): addr 0x0000, count 8; returns relay 1-8 state (bit0=relay1)
| FC02 (Read Discrete Inputs): addr 0x0000, count 8; optocoupler 1-8 state (bit0=ch1)
| FC03 (Read Holding Registers): device address (addr 0), baud rate status (addr 1000)
| FC10 (Write Multiple Registers): device address (addr 0), baud rate (addr 1001),

registers.name: Device address R/W (range 1-255; default 255; write via FC10 from broadcast addr 0)
Baud rate set W (0x02=4800 0x03=9600 0x04=19200; write via FC10)
